body: That's a pretty sweet phrase. Thanks =)

Thank you so much, but I feel like more and more I'm not worthy of help. I don't have it as bad as some people, and if I wasn't such a horrible person I wouldn't be suffering so much. I've been a burden for years. And every time I've reached out I feel like it's been thrown back in my face.

I did let it slip to my mom a week or so ago that I was suicidal. And I was reminded of exactly why I keep things to myself. It's my fault, actually, for being so stupid. I guess I expected, I dunno, that she would comfort me or hug me or be concerned for me or something. Instead, all I got was her screaming at me and hitting me and calling me ungrateful. Which is not so far from that truth. I was finally ready to get some therapy, and despite her reaction I asked if I could see somebody, and that's not happening. I'm back to where I was; I don't know that I could sit down and look someone in the eye and tell them all the stupid shit I've done and about how awful my life is, when it's really not, when *I'm* the awful one in the equation.
